The '''Intamm Enclave''' was the stronghold of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Intamm clan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. It was located in the dense jungles of the [[Chekkoo Province]].
